title: 東京大賞典の後に・トップ→トップ！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Tokyo Daishoten draws to a close, and the winning concert is an incredible event that attendees will never forget.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite that, Smart Falcon confesses to feeling frustrated that it didn't draw fervor on par with that of the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unaware of the brilliance of G1 turf races, the other dirt runners are content with how things are. Smart Falcon realizes she needs to lift everyone up with her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our next race goal is the February Stakes. Smart Falcon appears strained, so I ask her to avoid pushing herself too hard.
